formula: 0.50 * Adjusted_P2 + 0.50 * Adjusted_P3, where Adjusted = clip(50 + (Raw - 50) * L(P1), 0.1, 99.9)

p3_issue_01_investigation.finding: When required RR blows out exponentially in overs 18-20, P3 drops severely (< 10.0) while P1 rises (> 90.0). Because P1 leverage L(P1) >= 1.25, multiplying the already-depressed P3 deviation (e.g. -46.4 * 1.348 = -62.5) causes Adjusted P3 to hit the floor boundary (0.1). As a result, the proposed leverage model amplifies the existing P3-ISSUE-01 penalty on tail-enders or finishers entering lost-cause chases (e.g. Mohammed Siraj 32.2 -> 2.6). The leverage architecture does NOT fix P3-ISSUE-01; it accentuates the underlying P3 distortion.
p3_issue_01_investigation.impact: Accentuates P3-ISSUE-01 in extreme hopeless chases.
p3_issue_01_investigation.recommendation: Preserve existing P3 in production for Phase 7G audit; address P3-ISSUE-01 dampener before final leverage production integration.

verdict_rationale: Model A Linear Bounded Leverage successfully resolves the core structural flaw of 25/35/40 by removing direct context tax on elite openers (+10.5 pts average boost for 100+ scores) and removing participation points for collapse failures (-14.3 pts penalty). Par invariance is mathematically exact (P1=50 -> L=1.000). However, observation B is required: in death-over hopeless chases (overs 18-20 with impossible RRR), high context leverage amplifies the uncalibrated P3-ISSUE-01 distortion (e.g. Siraj dropped to 2.6). Production integration must proceed only after observing or mitigating P3-ISSUE-01.
